subtitle: Career Planning Seminar II
teachers:
YOSHIMURA Osamu
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: By clarifying goals to graduate school or industry / work to be employed, it is possible to realize human formation and self-improvement through self-discovery and self-development in order to realize the goal. By mastering this subject you will be able to clarify the view of occupation, and to select jobs and companies according to their course decisions, abilities and aptitudes.And further improve your aptitude and academic ability by yourself.
advice:
For this lesson, the following content is the standard, but please refer to the lesson management plan for each department that is distributed at the time of the orientation at the beginning of the semester for details.
1. Lecture 1: Lecture by corporate personnel officer
2. Lecture 2: Lecture by graduates
3. Lecture 3: Experiences from M2 and B4
4. Create a self-appealing seat
5..Self-analysis
6.Employment simulation test: general common knowledge and comprehensiveness

requiredKnowledge: The Career Planning Seminar I and II, which are offered in the first and second semesters, are aimed at job hunting in the next fiscal year, and are designed to prepare for the current severe job-front. All students need to take the course to prepare for the job hunting and prepare for the job hunting, regardless of whether they are going to school or finding employment.

activityGoals.body: Explain the activity process from course selection to decision.
Collect, analyze and utilize information necessary for graduate school entry and job hunting activities.
Acquire the aptitude, academic ability and problem solving ability required by society.
Utilize knowledge of applied chemistry and experimental technology to contribute to the sustainable development

achievementLevels.ideal:
① You can think deeply about the relationship between your life plan and your career.
② In order to discover your own suitability and course, you can do the thought and action necessary for it.
③ Study the knowledge, ability, nutrition and qualifications necessary for setting and achieving course objectives, and prepare and respond by yourselves.
④ You can logically explain your policies and goals, such as entering your graduate school or going to work, so that others can understand it.
